title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast noir comic with chiaroscuro lighting, moody shadows, and blood-red accents
short_summary: In rain-soaked 1950s New Harbor, ex-cop Jack Malone is hired by nightclub singer Veronica Steele to find her missing brother. As Jack investigates, he uncovers a web of mob debts, police corruption, and betrayal. Each clue draws him deeper into the city’s darkness, forcing him to confront his own ghosts and the price of justice.
world_context: New Harbor City, 1950s—fog-choked streets, neon-lit clubs, rain-slick tenements. Police and mob are entwined, jazz and secrets fill the air. Technology is analog, justice is elusive.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face with a perpetual five o'clock shadow, dark hair streaked with gray, limp in left leg
quirks: Rubs a silver dollar for luck
characters.typical_attire: Trench coat, fedora, rumpled suit, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Former cop, wounded in the line of duty, now a private investigator haunted by past failures.
characters.motivations: Driven by guilt and a need for redemption, determined to find the truth no matter the cost.

characters.name: Veronica Steele
characters.physical_traits: Striking, pale skin, black hair in glossy waves, green eyes sharp as glass, dancer’s poise
quirks: Wears green gloves at all times
Voice with a jazz singer’s timbre
characters.typical_attire: Elegant dresses, silk scarves, always gloves
characters.backstory: Nightclub singer and owner, fiercely protective of her brother Eddie, hiding secrets behind her glamour.
characters.motivations: Desperate to find her missing brother and keep her club afloat, torn between loyalty and survival.

characters.name: Eddie Chen
characters.physical_traits: Slim, nervous energy, quick smile, short black hair, always glancing over his shoulder
characters.typical_attire: Cheap suit, loosened tie, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Veronica’s younger brother, caught up in debts and trouble, vanished after leaving the club.
characters.motivations: Wants to escape his past mistakes and protect his sister, but is in over his head.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Stocky, cold blue eyes, slicked-back hair, scar on left cheek
characters.typical_attire: Dark tailored suit, gloves, heavy boots
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer, rumored to be involved in Eddie’s disappearance, feared in the underworld.
characters.motivations: Loyal to the mob, but haunted by debts and secrets. Will do anything to survive.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, thinning blond hair, pockmarked skin, heavy brow
characters.typical_attire: Police uniform or rumpled shirt and suspenders
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, on the take from the mob, blocks investigations that threaten his interests.
characters.motivations: Protect his power and secrets, keep the city’s rot hidden, and maintain his own survival.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack Malone, haunted ex-cop, sits in his rain-lashed office. Veronica Steele arrives, desperate to find her missing brother Eddie. Their tense conversation sets the case in motion, hinting at secrets and danger beneath New Harbor’s neon-lit surface.

scenes.scene_description: Rain pounds the city as neon glows outside Jack’s office. The city’s insomnia is palpable.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in high-contrast noir style. Establishing shot of a rain-soaked New Harbor street at night. Neon signs flicker across puddles, casting red and blue reflections. Jack Malone’s office window glows dimly above a battered door. The city is blurred by rain, with a lone patrol car gliding past. Moody, chiaroscuro lighting. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Rain falls on the city, neon lights reflecting in puddles.

dialogue.text: Rain. The city never sleeps, but it dreams in neon and shadows.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, harsh reds, deep blacks

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of Jack’s office window from the street. Cigarette smoke curls from a cracked window, silhouetted against jaundiced lamplight. The outline of a man in a fedora is visible through the glass. Rain streaks down the pane. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s silhouette is visible through rain-streaked glass.
panels.color_palette: muted grays, yellow lamplight, hints of red

pages.page_description: Establishes the rainy, neon-lit city and Jack’s office as a lonely outpost.

scenes.scene_description: Jack sits alone, surrounded by files and smoke, haunted by pain and memories.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of Jack’s cramped office. Files sprawl across a battered desk, some yellowed, others marked with red ink. A battered lamp casts jaundiced light, cigarette smoke curling in the air. Jack sits hunched, rubbing his knee, fedora pushed back. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack sits at his desk, lost in thought, surrounded by case files.

dialogue.text: Old wounds ache. Some never heal, even when the rain stops.

panels.color_palette: sepia tones, yellow lamplight, gray shadows

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Jack’s hand in his pocket, fingers rubbing a worn silver dollar. The coin glints in the lamplight, his knuckles scarred. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack rubs his lucky silver dollar, lost in thought.
panels.color_palette: silver, muted skin tones, yellow highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot from behind Jack, looking out his rain-streaked window. A patrol car glides by on the street below, its headlights slicing through the gloom. Neon reflections shimmer on wet concrete. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack gazes out the window as a patrol car passes.

dialogue.text: The city hunts, but never for the right ghosts.

pages.page_description: Jack’s solitude, pain, and the city’s restless energy are established.

scenes.scene_description: Veronica Steele enters, her presence announced by scent and silhouette.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of Jack’s office door opening. Veronica’s silhouette is framed in the doorway, backlit by hallway light. The outline of her green gloves and the shimmer of rain-damp silk are visible. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica enters, her silhouette dramatic in the doorway.

dialogue.text: She arrived on a whisper—cloves and rain-damp silk.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Veronica stepping into the office, her black hair glossy, green gloves tight on her hands. Jack rises slightly from his chair, wary. The lamplight catches her sharp green eyes. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Veronica’s face: pale skin, black hair, sharp green eyes, a hint of rain on her cheek. Her lips are parted, voice poised between hope and fear. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica’s expression reveals urgency and vulnerability.

dialogue.text: Eyes like broken jade, voice with a jazz beat.

pages.page_description: Veronica’s dramatic entrance, her presence and mystery established.

scenes.scene_description: Veronica and Jack converse, tension and subtext thick in the smoke.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Two-shot of Jack and Veronica across the battered desk. Jack sits, notebook open, cigarette burning in the ashtray. Veronica stands, hands clasped, green gloves vivid against the desk’s clutter. Smoke curls between them. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: I need you to find my brother. Eddie. He’s missing.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack, notebook open, pen poised. His face is shadowed, eyes sharp, lips pursed. The battered desk is cluttered with files and a silver dollar. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack questions Veronica, skeptical but attentive.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Veronica’s gloved hands gripping her purse tightly, knuckles white beneath green silk. The purse trembles slightly. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica’s anxiety is visible in her hands.

dialogue.text: Two nights. He left the club, didn’t come home. Cops won’t touch it.

pages.page_description: Jack and Veronica’s tense conversation, motives and fears revealed.

scenes.scene_description: Jack presses for details; Veronica’s mask slips, revealing fear and defiance.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack leaning forward, eyes narrowed, tapping his battered notebook. Veronica stands across from him, her posture tense, lips pressed tight. Smoke drifts between them. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Veronica’s face, her eyes downcast, lips parted as if about to confess. A single tear glistens on her cheek, caught in the lamplight. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Everyone has enemies in New Harbor.

panels.color_palette: pale skin, black, green, yellow highlight

pages.page_description: Jack’s interrogation, Veronica’s fear and resignation.

scenes.scene_description: Jack asserts his experience; Veronica responds with a challenge. Thunder breaks outside.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack, tapping his notebook, eyes locked on Veronica. His expression is hard, determined. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Start at the beginning. And don’t lie. I can smell a lie, even in this rain.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Veronica’s lips curling into a half-smile, half-challenge. Her green glove brushes her cheek. Portrait 4:5.

A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of the office window as thunder cracks outside. Lightning silhouettes the city skyline, rain streaming down the glass. Jack and Veronica are visible in the background, frozen in a moment of realization. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Thunder breaks, signaling a shift in the case.

dialogue.text: Thunder broke over the city. Something had shifted.

pages.page_description: Jack and Veronica’s final exchange, thunder signaling a turning point.
